name: James Morrison
discretionary_target: Ask whether his email is also current — he only asked about notifications

turns.text: Hi, my customer ID is CUST-002. Can you check on order ORD-2001 for me? And I really need to figure out why I'm not getting delivery notifications — it's been happening for a while now.
Yeah, that's me. James Morrison. I can verify — my email is james.morrison@email.com and my account phone number should be on file there.
Right, so the order — ORD-2001. Where's that at in the system? I'm not sure if it's been shipped yet or if there's an issue with it.
Oh, that could be it actually. I did change my phone number a few months ago. I don't think I updated it in your system. That's probably why I'm missing the notifications. Can we fix that?
My new number is 555-0147. So once you update that, I should start getting notifications again, right? And is the order on track? Like, is that normal for where it should be at this point?
Okay, that sounds good. As long as the order's moving normally and my notifications are set up now, I think that covers it. Thanks for getting that sorted out.
Yep, I got what I needed. Thanks again.
